steps.title: Read the active profile before adding rules
steps.body: In Reaction Profiles read Active Reaction Profile and Speaking style. Change the active profile only when you intend its rules and style to govern reactions. Add Profile creates a separate set; Rename and Delete change that profile. Confirm the selected profile when you return to the page.

steps.title: Inspect one rule from match to action
steps.body: In Reaction Rules open one rule and read Reaction rule, Enabled, Action, Strictness and Emotion override. Repeat mode and Nth match interval decide how often a matching change may fire. Use Add Rule for a new one and Remove Rule only for the selected rule. A saved rule is configuration; the Advanced Prompt preview is the readable check.

steps.title: Read the prompt preview before trusting a rule
steps.body: Open Advanced Prompt and use Review Prompt Preview to read what the active profile and rules supply. This preview does not trigger a reaction. If wording conflicts with your intended rule, return to Reaction Rules rather than editing the template first. Restore recommended prompt returns the shared text to the recommended version.

steps.title: Keep a recoverable prompt state
steps.body: Note customized prompt text before using Restore recommended prompt, and inspect the preview afterward. The recommended prompt is a baseline, not proof that a rule fires. A rule with Enabled on still depends on real heart-rate data and its match conditions.
